What SplitsWorkout does

SplitsWorkout connects the pieces of planning a workout that are usually scattered across different sites. You can find a workout split that fits your schedule, goal and experience, build it in the planner, look up any exercise in the exercise library, learn how each muscle is trained in the muscle guide, and estimate your calories and macros with the calculators.

How we approach content

We try to give the most useful answer and the clearest next step. Where training science has a consensus we say so; where it does not — for example the ideal training frequency — we explain the trade-offs instead of pretending one answer fits everyone. We do not invent studies, experts or statistics.

Who writes it

Content is produced by the SplitsWorkout editorial team using software tools for data processing and drafting. We are not doctors, dietitians or registered coaches, and nothing here is medical advice. See how recommendations and calculators work on the methodology pages.

Advertising and independence

SplitsWorkout is free to use and may be supported by display advertising in the future. Advertising never changes our recommendations, and we do not accept payment to rank a split or an exercise.

Corrections and feedback

Spotted a mistake or want an exercise added? Please contact us. Corrections are reviewed and the page updated.

Not sure where to start?

Tell us your schedule, goal and experience — we will rank the splits that fit.
